note: The narrator's lines, in order. `scene` says which part of the film a line belongs to. Edit a line, run `pnpm --filter @outside/promo voiceover`, then render: only changed lines are voiced again.

lines.text: You've found a place to stay. The photos look great.
But a listing only shows you the room.
Outside shows you the rest. It reads the live web around the address: things to do, today's prices, the weather for your dates.
About ten seconds later, it's ready.
It knows when you're going. In January, it finds ski areas and toboggan runs. In July, lakes and rafting.
Tell it what you like, and the video is rebuilt around you.
Every rating, every price, every minute of the drive comes from a live source. And every number the voice says is checked against it.
Outside. See what's outside, before you book.
